tagline: Random in-key melody loop played by a built-in synth
description: MelodyMaker generates a four-bar melody in a chosen key (major or natural minor) by a random walk over the scale, then loops it in time with the host transport through its own 8-voice synth. You'd use it to sketch melodic ideas and export the result as a MIDI file. It loads as an instrument, not a MIDI effect: it plays audio and does not send MIDI to other tracks.

features.name: Key and scale
features.description: Twelve root keys and Major or Minor; notes stay within two octaves above the root.

features.name: Transport-synced loop
features.description: The 16-beat melody follows the host's tempo and song position and repeats while the transport plays.

features.name: Built-in synth
features.description: Sine, saw, square or triangle oscillator with an ADSR envelope (attack/decay 1 ms to 2 s, release to 3 s).

features.name: Effects
features.description: Low-pass filter (200 Hz to 20 kHz), a feedback delay and a reverb, each with its own level.

features.name: MIDI file export
features.description: Saves the current melody as a .mid file at 120 BPM in 4/4.
